jobs.title: Director, Public & Alternative Investments, Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

As Director, Data Engineering for the Public Markets and Alternate Assets (PMAA) team, you will build and publish the enterprise market data products that power investment strategies across our public markets and alternate assets businesses. Partnering closely with your business-aligned product owner, you will lead a talented team of data engineers and analysts and own the end-to-end lifecycle of PMAA data, from vendor and internal feeds through to trusted, well-documented data products used by investment teams, analytics platforms and AI agents. You will set the technical direction for a modern AWS data platform, establish the semantic and knowledge graph foundations that connect data across asset classes, and ensure every data product meets the standards of timeliness, quality, licensing compliance and control that investment decisions demand.

The Team

CPP Investments invests across public and private markets, supported by technology and data capabilities that enable informed investment decisions and long-term value creation.

Within PMAA, this role leads market data engineering and the development of enterprise data products that support investment professionals, quantitative and research teams. The team works with investment, product, architecture, technology and governance partners to deliver reliable, accessible and AI-ready market data.

Accountabilities

Define and execute the multi-year data engineering strategy and roadmap for PMAA market data products, partnering with the product owner to align priorities with investment needs and enterprise architecture standards.
Own the target-state AWS data platform architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, governance and consumption, making design and build-versus-buy decisions that balance scalability, resilience, security and cost.
Lead the development and adoption of enterprise data products across public and private markets, including pricing, reference data, corporate actions and benchmarks, with clear ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.
Establish semantic data capabilities, including RDF knowledge graphs on Amazon Neptune, and enable governed access to AI-ready data through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills and Amazon Quick.
Ensure reliable, timely and secure data delivery through observability, automated quality controls, incident management, AWS Lake Formation, data lineage and market data licensing and entitlement controls.
Lead agile roadmap delivery and engineering excellence, embedding CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and reusable frameworks while engaging senior stakeholders, investment teams and strategic technology and data partners.
Build, coach and develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and career growth.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field; a graduate degree is an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms or software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native data platforms and leading complex agile programs.
Strong understanding of capital markets, investment management and market and reference data, including experience with major data vendors, licensing, entitlements and usage controls; private markets experience is an asset.
Advanced AWS architecture expertise equivalent to Solutions Architect – Professional, including security, IAM, networking, resilience and cost optimization, together with hands-on technical depth in Apache Spark (PySpark or Scala), AWS Glue or EMR, Airflow/MWAA, AWS DMS and Amazon RDS/Aurora.
Expertise in enterprise data product design, AWS Lake Formation governance, data contracts, service levels and consumption patterns, along with RDF, SPARQL, ontology design, Amazon Neptune, MCP servers, agent skills and AI-assisted analytics using Amazon Quick.
Ability to guide engineering teams across cloud-native development, data quality, observability and delivery practices. Experience with lakehouse technologies, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data cataloguing, financial ontologies, Amazon Bedrock or GraphRAG is an asset; relevant AWS certifications are also assets.
Inclusive people leadership, sound judgment and strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to investment professionals and executives, influence stakeholders and manage strategic vendor partnerships.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Engineering

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. The Director, Data Engineering for Cyber Analytics will be a key contributor in helping Mastercard develop and deliver actionable insights and products to mitigate cyber vulnerabilities across the Mastercard ecosystem.

Role

Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve data storage, pipelines, and ETL processes.
Lead the design and build of graph database solutions and data models that support cyber analytics use cases.
Partner with data scientists to understand existing ML and AI applications, identify optimization opportunities, and craft processes and solutions that streamline data engineering integration.
Oversee the integration and management of data from various sources and storage systems to produce cohesive datasets for analysis and modeling.
Partner with software engineering, IT, Info Sec, and infrastructure teams to deploy and validate production artifacts.
Lead, develop, and grow a team of highly skilled data engineers.

All About You

Strong data engineering skills, including building data pipelines and infrastructure for ML and AI applications, with a solid understanding of ML and AI concepts to build solutions together with data scientists.
Proficiency in graph databases and graph modeling techniques.
Proficiency in Databricks, Spark, and AWS, with working knowledge of on-prem distributions (Apache, Hadoop, Oracle).
Skilled in databases and big data tools such as Hive, Impala, OOZIE, Airflow, and NIFI, with working knowledge of Shell scripting and Linux/Unix systems.
Strong computer science fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and complexity analysis.
Proven ability to lead and develop a team of data engineers.
Skilled at delegating, organizing, and motivating a team, and at prioritizing competing requests across multi-person projects.
Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical and business partners.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, propose solutions, and implement them with cross-functional teams.
Clear, persuasive communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, in writing and verbally.
Curiosity and adaptability, with the ability to learn new domains quickly and stay open to alternative ideas.

Preferred Skills

A degree in a technical field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or Computer Science, or equivalent skills gained through hands-on work.
Knowledge of the payments, cyber, and/or fraud domains.
Knowledge of web crawling and scraping.
Exposure to agentic AI.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Pay Ranges

Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

jobs.title: Director, Delivery CX AI
jobs.description:
Director, CX AI Delivery

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

This role will operate remotely in the United States
or Canada
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Governance & Growth

Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation

Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

Leadership & Talent Development

Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

Operational & Financial Stewardship

Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

Qualifications

10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Compensation Range: CA$150K - CA$190K

jobs.title: Director, Advanced Network Planning
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Ciena is seeking a technical leader to direct the Advanced Network Planning group within the Navigator Network Control Suite Product Line Management organization. This leader will guide a team of highly qualified network analysts who support Ciena’s largest customers on tactical and strategic network planning initiatives. The role also shapes the Navigator roadmap by identifying emerging customer and market needs, directing research, and incubating advanced network optimization algorithms and tools.

How You Will Make An Impact

Lead executive and technical engagements with Ciena’s global sales organization and customers, using deep domain expertise to guide the design, optimization, and analysis of optical, IP, and data centre network architectures.
Anticipate future network planning needs by synthesizing customer challenges, market insights, and technology trends, then translate those findings into prioritized research themes, product hypotheses, and planning tool concepts.
Set the technical research agenda for new network planning and optimization approaches, establish rigorous evaluation criteria, and validate the resulting methods through real customer network planning projects. Recent research areas have included forecasting, capacity planning automation, route and spectrum assignment optimization, failure analysis, and service availability modeling.
Define and communicate a compelling technical vision for advanced network planning, tailoring the message to align business leaders, customers, engineers, and product stakeholders.
Provide technical direction and partner with Product Line Management, engineering, and product development teams to translate validated concepts into scalable planning capabilities and bring them successfully to market.
Partner cross-functionally with hardware teams to model and analyze alternative network architectures, providing data-driven insights that influence product roadmap decisions.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of network planning experts, establishing technical standards, strengthening critical capabilities, and creating an environment of rigorous analysis, innovation, and continuous learning.

The Must Haves

15+ years of telecommunications experience spanning deep technical roles and positions with product, customer, or business leadership accountability.
10+ years expertise in optical and IP transport technologies, including network architecture, control, resiliency, capacity engineering, and optimization trade-offs.
Substantial experience in network planning, architecture analysis, optimization, and the application of analytical methods to complex customer networks.
Proven experience providing technical and product leadership for telecommunications software applications from concept and validation through productization, deployment, and measurable market adoption.
Experience with the use of AI tools as aids to software code development.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical topics, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions across engineering, product, sales, services, customers, and executive leadership.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate and apply AI-enabled methods to network planning, optimization, modeling, and decision support, with sound judgment regarding data quality, model validation, explainability, operational risk, and measurable customer outcomes.
Experience using AI-enabled tools and methods to accelerate software development, explore architectures, prototype algorithms, analyze networks, and improve engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate technical review and validation.

Nice To Haves

Experience developing, deploying, or governing AI and machine-learning technologies in telecommunications or other complex, high-availability environments.
Customer-facing experience relating to network consultancy services or similar.
Hands-on experience with Python or comparable analytical programming tools for prototyping, data analysis, optimization, or model validation.

The Salary Range For This Role, In Canada, Is

$154,000.00 - $246,000.00 CAD

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

Job Description

What if you could redefine what’s possible?

With us, you can. You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity.
People who get it.

We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science‑based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.

We are pathfinders and impact makers.

We are Visioneers.

We are WSP.

The Opportunity

Successful projects don't happen by accident. They are delivered through strong governance, disciplined execution, effective project controls, and leaders who give teams the tools and support they need to succeed.

WSP is seeking an experienced and passionate project delivery leader to join our Earth & Environment team as Director, Project Governance, BC & Yukon. This is a unique opportunity
to shape and lead the project management function across one of WSP's largest and most diverse regions. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Earth & Environment, BC & Yukon, you will establish and drive a regional project governance and project management office (PMO)
approach that strengthens consistency, accountability, and delivery performance across a diverse portfolio of environmental engineering projects.

As the leader responsible for project governance, project controls and project management capability, you will oversee our Project Controllers and Project Control Administrators while building the systems, processes, tools and performance rhythms that enable successful project delivery. You will work closely with operational leaders and project teams to improve project outcomes, strengthen commercial performance, enhance project management capability and create a more predictable and disciplined approach to delivering work.

This role is ideal for someone energized by project management excellence
, governance, continuous improvement and helping others succeed. If you are passionate about creating the frameworks, insights and support systems that allow teams to consistently deliver successful outcomes for clients and the business, we would love to hear from you.

Your Impact

Establish and lead a consistent project governance and controls framework across the BC & Yukon Earth & Environment business, strengthening accountability, discipline and delivery excellence.
Drive adoption of project management standards, tools and best practices to improve project execution, predictability, commercial performance and client outcomes.
Provide oversight of portfolio health, using performance insights to identify risks, trends and opportunities, and lead reviews or recovery efforts for strategic, high-risk or underperforming projects.
Lead and develop Project Controllers and Project Control Administrators, aligning resources and capabilities to provide effective support across the regional portfolio.
Build project management capability through practical tools, training, coaching and knowledge sharing, while serving as a trusted advisor to leaders and project teams.
Strengthen forecasting, risk management, change management and commercial practices to improve profitability and reduce delivery risk.
Partner with operations, finance, commercial, risk and legal teams to align project delivery with regional and national priorities.
Lead continuous improvement and lessons learned initiatives, and support strategic pursuits, business planning and key initiatives by ensuring project readiness, governance and delivery risks are effectively considered.

The Skills That Set You Apart

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline.
Professional certification or designation such as PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent project governance, risk, or program management credentials considered an asset.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in project management, project controls, program oversight, governance, or professional consulting environments.
Proven experience overseeing complex, multidisciplinary project portfolios and supporting successful project delivery across diverse stakeholder groups.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, project controls, commercial management, and performance reporting.
Demonstrated success leading organizational change, continuous improvement, and capability-building initiatives.
Experience identifying and managing financial, operational, contractual, regulatory, and project delivery risks.
Strong business acumen, financial literacy, and an ability to translate project performance data into actionable business insights.
Experience working with enterprise project and financial management systems, such as Oracle, to support governance, forecasting, and decision-making.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executives, operational leaders, project sponsors, and project teams.
A collaborative leadership style with a proven ability to influence, drive accountability, and achieve results in a matrixed environment without direct authority.
A passion for project delivery excellence, continuous improvement, and helping project teams achieve successful outcomes for clients and the business.

Why Choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity. The brightest engineers, advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

Proudly Canadian – we are a Top 100 Employer in Canada for 2026.
A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.
Limitless opportunities start here. Whether it’s across the country or around the globe, we help you tailor your role to match your ambition — because your growth drives ours.
Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

jobs.title: DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
jobs.description:
About The Lacroix Medical Group

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics
Operating Rooms
Biomedical Laboratory

The organization has experienced strong and sustained growth since its founding in 2009 and currently employs nearly 350 people. As part of its strategic plan, the Group aims to accelerate its national and international development.

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation.

The Mandate

In a context of sustained growth and transformation of its activities, Lacroix Medical Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology who will actively contribute to the organization's technological evolution.

Reporting directly to the President and CEO, the Director of IT plays a strategic role across the entire network. They are responsible for defining, structuring, and developing the IT function to effectively support the organization's operations, growth, and ambitions.

They provide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, business systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence.

He is also responsible for the performance of his team and the organization's technology partner ecosystem. This role is for an experienced, business-oriented, and results-driven IT leader who can combine strategic vision with excellent execution. Your Key Responsibilities IT Strategy and Governance: Define and deploy the IT vision and master plan in line with the strategic, operational, and financial priorities of Groupe médical Lacroix. Advise senior management on investments, risks, and key technological choices.

Performance and Business Continuity

Ensure the performance, robustness, and high availability of the infrastructure and technology platforms essential to the network's medical and administrative activities, including ERP, CRM, DME, LIS, SaaS, and cloud environments.

Digital Transformation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and prioritize initiatives to transform the organization through technology, data valorization, automation, and artificial intelligence. Lead major technology projects and ensure their effective integration into operations.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

Maintain high standards in cybersecurity, information protection, redundancy, and business continuity in an environment where system availability and the protection of medical data are critical.

Leadership and Organizational Performance

Lead and develop a competent, autonomous, and accountable IT team. Establish clear objectives and performance indicators, ensure rigorous budget management, and optimize the contribution of suppliers, consultants, and technology partners.

An Executive Role Close to Operations

At Lacroix Medical Group, technology must meet the realities on the ground.

The IT Director will therefore need to maintain close contact with the various business units and network teams to understand their needs, anticipate challenges, and ensure that technological solutions contribute concretely to operational performance and service quality.

The position consequently requires excellent mobility. The successful candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the Lacroix network in Quebec to meet with teams, support projects, and remain connected to the operational realities of the various facilities.

This on-the-ground presence is an essential component of the role and not an occasional responsibility.

The mandate expressly includes regular visits to service points.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an experienced manager with a strong business acumen and excellent technological expertise, recognized for their leadership, judgment, and ability to drive organizational growth.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

A bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field;
15 to 20 years of experience in information technology, including a minimum of 5 years in a management role;
Mastery of software architecture and project management;
A solid understanding of multi-site and cloud infrastructures;
Good knowledge of SaaS environments and major business platforms: ERP, CRM, financial systems, telephony, Microsoft 365, and others;
A thorough understanding of the issues cybersecurity, data governance and valorization, and artificial intelligence;
Proven experience in team management and development;
Recognized leadership in transformation and change management;

Please only apply if you are based in the location listed on this job posting. Remote does not mean the position is open worldwide.

Compensation:
C$180,000–C$200,000 base salary
, based on experience, plus a performance-based annual bonus targeted at 15%–20% of base salary

Build Financial Clarity Across a Growing Group of Companies

Rothenbury Group
owns and operates technology-enabled businesses across real estate, property management, brokerage, leasing, maintenance, staffing, media, and other service industries.

We are hiring an experienced Vice President of Finance
to strengthen financial reporting, cash-flow visibility, forecasting, controls, documentation, and executive decision support across the group.

This is a senior finance leadership role for someone who can enter a complex, multi-company environment, assess the current state of financial information, identify gaps and risks, establish priorities, and provide management with clear, practical recommendations.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership while coordinating with internal finance staff, accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners.

Our Hiring Process

Please apply with your resume and a brief summary of your senior finance experience.

If your background aligns with the role, you will receive an email within 24 to 48 hours of applying
with a link to complete a pre-recorded online interview
.

The interview will help us better understand your finance leadership background, technical capabilities, reporting approach, judgment, and experience working with complex financial information. Selected candidates will then be invited to continue through the next stage of the interview process.

Your Mandate

The Vice President of Finance will be responsible for creating greater visibility, organization, accuracy, and accountability across the group’s financial operations.

You Will Be Expected To

Assess the condition of financial records, reporting processes, controls, and supporting documentation
Identify missing information, unexplained balances, inconsistencies, financial risks, process gaps, and priority action items
Improve cash-flow visibility, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting
Build clear reporting structures that help leadership understand performance, obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions
Strengthen reconciliations, approval processes, internal controls, and finance operating discipline
Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external financial, legal, tax, banking, and advisory partners
Provide practical recommendations that support immediate decisions and long-term financial improvement

Key Responsibilities

Review, organize, analyze, summarize, and reconcile financial and accounting information across multiple companies
Review banking, payroll, tax, ownership, investment, corporate, vendor, client, receivable, payable, budgeting, and forecasting records
Prepare executive summaries, management reports, financial models, dashboards, schedules, trackers, reconciliations, workpapers, and memoranda
Develop clear reporting on cash position, cash-flow requirements, expenses, receivables, payables, budgets, forecasts, and financial risks
Identify incomplete records, unexplained transactions, reporting weaknesses, control concerns, and process failures
Improve finance-related document organization, file structures, naming conventions, supporting records, and document readiness
Strengthen month-end, reconciliation, and management-reporting processes
Support budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, financial modelling, and operational finance planning
Review and improve internal controls, approval workflows, finance policies, and accountability standards
Coordinate with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners
Clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, unresolved questions, risks, recommendations, and required next steps
Support financial clean-up projects, transitions, system changes, special reviews, and other senior finance initiatives
Provide senior leadership with accurate, timely, and decision-ready financial information

Required Experience And Qualifications

The successful candidate will have:

10+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, controllership, FP&A, corporate finance, or senior financial management
At least 5 years in a senior finance leadership position, such as Vice President of Finance, Director of Finance, Controller, Head of Finance, or an equivalent role
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field
A CPA, CA, CMA, CGA, MBA, or comparable senior finance qualification is strongly preferred
Strong experience reviewing complex financial records, reports, reconciliations, budgets, forecasts, and supporting documentation
Advanced understanding of financial reporting, cash-flow management, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and finance operations
Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards, financial models, trackers, memoranda, and management updates
Strong ability to identify financial gaps, inconsistencies, control weaknesses, process issues, and business risks
Experience working with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and executive stakeholders
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modelling, reconciliations, reporting, and structured data analysis
Experience using accounting systems and managing information related to banking, payroll, receivables, payables, vendors, clients, budgets, forecasts, and corporate records
Excellent written communication, documentation, and presentation skills
Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and attention to detail
Ability to manage evolving priorities and provide clear recommendations with limited supervision

Experience That Will Stand Out

Preference May Be Given To Candidates With

Experience overseeing finance across multiple companies, entities, business units, or operating divisions
Real estate accounting or finance experience
Property management accounting experience
Asset management or development accounting experience
Experience working in a founder-led, entrepreneurial, or rapidly growing organization
Experience improving an existing finance function rather than only maintaining established systems
Experience strengthening reporting, financial controls, documentation, systems, or cash-flow visibility during a period of growth or transition
Experience combining strategic finance leadership with hands-on financial review and problem-solving

The Leader Who Will Succeed Here

The right person is highly analytical but also practical.

They can review a large volume of financial information, determine what is reliable, identify what is missing, and separate immediate financial risks from lower-priority clean-up work. They are comfortable working with senior management and can explain complex financial matters clearly and directly.

They do not simply identify problems. They organize the work, establish priorities, recommend solutions, and create the reporting and financial discipline required to support better decisions.

They are equally comfortable reviewing detailed reconciliations, preparing executive reporting, coordinating with external advisors, and advising leadership on financial priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Success In This Role Will Mean

Leadership has clearer and more reliable visibility into the financial position of the group
Cash-flow requirements, financial obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions are easier to understand
Financial records and supporting documentation are organized, complete, and decision-ready
Management reporting is timely, accurate, and useful
Reconciliations, controls, approvals, and finance processes operate with greater discipline
Missing information and unresolved financial issues are identified and assigned clear next steps
Accountants, bookkeepers, advisors, and internal teams operate with stronger structure and accountability
The finance function becomes more scalable as Rothenbury Group continues to grow

Compensation and Opportunity

The base salary range for this position is C$180,000–C$200,000
, based on the candidate’s finance leadership experience, professional designation, multi-company background, technical capabilities, industry exposure, and overall fit.

The Successful Candidate Will Also Be Eligible For a Performance-based Annual Bonus Targeted At 15%–20% Of Base Salary. Bonus Performance May Be Assessed Using Factors Such As

Financial reporting accuracy and timeliness
Cash-flow visibility and forecasting quality
Strength of financial controls
Completion of reconciliations and financial clean-up priorities
Improvement in management reporting
Finance-process discipline
Quality of executive decision support
Progress in building a scalable and accountable finance function

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance leadership position with meaningful influence across a diverse and growing group of businesses.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Equipment Planning and Biomedical Services is accountable for clinical and non-clinical asset planning, maintenance and management. The role provides overall leadership to Mackenzie Health equipment needs for short-term and long-term asset planning, tracking, maintenance, management, and refresh. The director is responsible for overseeing all facility and redevelopment work required to plan, procure, and complete installation of medical equipment. This role also provides Director-level leadership to the Central Equipment and Biomedical Engineering departments. This role works within an environment that has Design-Build-Finance-Maintain (DBFP) equipment relationships, Managed Equipment Services (MES) contract, as well as a traditional in-house biomedical engineering service and support model. This role also works closely with Mackenzie Health Redevelopment department to plan, procure, and implement the Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) components of various redevelopment projects. Additionally, the Director coordinates efforts with various departments to develop and maintain a multi-year equipment plan and budget, ensuring appropriate inventory levels, mitigation of corporate risk, and balances demand with broader organizational need.

Primary Responsibilities

Maintain current knowledge of laws, ordinances, and regulations pertaining to corporate purchasing practices.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, develop a multi year clinical technology strategy, in conjunction with clinical and nonclinical leaders, and that aligns with organizational priorities. The strategy must include centralized purchasing/procurement of materials, equipment, machinery, and services required for operations, projects, and capital investments.
Responsible for the implementation of all Equipment projects from needs identification through to commissioning and on-going maintenance.
Manage and oversee all aspects of large-scale equipment installation projects including managing internal and external stakeholders, shop drawing reviews, scope of work development, project schedule development, budget management, reporting, commissioning, training, and close-out documentation.
Work collaboratively with the Digital Health portfolio to ensure all required integrations are planned and implemented to support equipment use.
Provide executive leadership with strategic and tactical advice, as well as risks and opportunities related to emerging healthcare technologies and long-term organizational planning.
Provide advice to management at all levels by using knowledge of equipment market and procurement.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, supervise or manage complex negotiations to settle commercial disputes and claims with suppliers by establishing goals and approving commercial settlements.
Manage the Philips MESP contract ($300M+ over 14-year contract life) and provide support to Philips and the Mackenzie Clinical team in the administration of the MESP contracted services.
Provide direct leadership to Biomedical Engineering and Central Equipment staff and services across a multi site hospital system.
Establish policies and procedures supporting safe equipment use and maintenance.
Lead service contract procurement and negotiations.
Monitor vendor performance and service level agreements.
Develop performance KPI for adequate service and support of medical equipment.
Work with multiple equipment vendors to coordinate design and construction activities, monitor performance and intervene to rectify issues.
Ensure the development and maintenance of work systems, goals and objectives, management systems, teamwork, and resource management for departments within the area of accountability.
Create and maintain asset management and tracking workflows and processes.
Create and maintain a space management program.
Space management includes oversight and recommendations to resolve all space requests. Working collaboratively with Redevelopment, Facilities, Clinical, Clinical Support Teams to ensure space allocations are prioritized and allocated based on hospital priorities.
Act as Chair of the Change Request Group (SAFES) to ensure alignment with corporate vision and mission.
Manage the intake, review, and implementation of all changes related to Space, Aesthetics, Furniture, Equipment, and Signage.
Provide leadership, support, and direction to program staff on issues related to performance, corporate direction, service delivery, staff development, Human Resources Management (HRM), realignment, and change management strategies.
Direct the process of establishing, implementing, and reporting on appropriate quality and productivity indicator measurement tools, based on provincial benchmarks, best practice standards, and legislative requirements.
Co-develop annual budgets and operating plans that align with the hospital’s programs and directives, and ensure the program stays within budget.
Ensure all assigned employees comply with hospital, government, and customer policies, procedures, and regulations.
Build external and internal business relationships to gather information, identify market and industry trends, build partnership and alliances to support and facilitate the hospital’s objectives and plans.
Management of Regulatory Requirements as applicable to equipment installations ensuring all documentation is submitted and approved by appropriate regulatory bodies to support the installation and use of medical equipment (e.g. HARP, CNSC).
Ensure effective procurement activities that meet the requirements and needs of the hospital’s internal stakeholders.
Ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors; investigate, report, debrief and take or direct corrective action as appropriate on incidents.
Manage human resources which include recruitment, selection and training.
Teach, coach and lead staff in the development and monitoring of quality indicators and improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders/organizations/community groups to achieve program objectives, integrate, and link services and foster partnerships across the continuum of service delivery.
Participate in education and training specific to current, relevant federal and provincial health and safety legislation, standards, and guidelines.

What must you have?

Minimum of a Master’s Degree or Master’s ready in Business, Economics, or in a related field, from an accredited university.
Minimum of 5-10 years experience working in equipment planning and procurement within a health care environment.
Minimum of five (5) years’ working in a senior leadership role, preferably in a health care environment.
Biomedical service leadership experience is required or similar experience that is deemed equivalent.

Please only apply if you are based in the location listed on this job posting. Remote does not mean the position is open worldwide.

Compensation:
C$180,000–C$200,000 base salary
, based on experience, plus a performance-based annual bonus targeted at 15%–20% of base salary

Build Financial Clarity Across a Growing Group of Companies

Rothenbury Group
owns and operates technology-enabled businesses across real estate, property management, brokerage, leasing, maintenance, staffing, media, and other service industries.

We are hiring an experienced Vice President of Finance
to strengthen financial reporting, cash-flow visibility, forecasting, controls, documentation, and executive decision support across the group.

This is a senior finance leadership role for someone who can enter a complex, multi-company environment, assess the current state of financial information, identify gaps and risks, establish priorities, and provide management with clear, practical recommendations.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership while coordinating with internal finance staff, accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners.

Our Hiring Process

Please apply with your resume and a brief summary of your senior finance experience.

If your background aligns with the role, you will receive an email within 24 to 48 hours of applying
with a link to complete a pre-recorded online interview
.

The interview will help us better understand your finance leadership background, technical capabilities, reporting approach, judgment, and experience working with complex financial information. Selected candidates will then be invited to continue through the next stage of the interview process.

Your Mandate

The Vice President of Finance will be responsible for creating greater visibility, organization, accuracy, and accountability across the group’s financial operations.

You Will Be Expected To

Assess the condition of financial records, reporting processes, controls, and supporting documentation
Identify missing information, unexplained balances, inconsistencies, financial risks, process gaps, and priority action items
Improve cash-flow visibility, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting
Build clear reporting structures that help leadership understand performance, obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions
Strengthen reconciliations, approval processes, internal controls, and finance operating discipline
Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external financial, legal, tax, banking, and advisory partners
Provide practical recommendations that support immediate decisions and long-term financial improvement

Key Responsibilities

Review, organize, analyze, summarize, and reconcile financial and accounting information across multiple companies
Review banking, payroll, tax, ownership, investment, corporate, vendor, client, receivable, payable, budgeting, and forecasting records
Prepare executive summaries, management reports, financial models, dashboards, schedules, trackers, reconciliations, workpapers, and memoranda
Develop clear reporting on cash position, cash-flow requirements, expenses, receivables, payables, budgets, forecasts, and financial risks
Identify incomplete records, unexplained transactions, reporting weaknesses, control concerns, and process failures
Improve finance-related document organization, file structures, naming conventions, supporting records, and document readiness
Strengthen month-end, reconciliation, and management-reporting processes
Support budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, financial modelling, and operational finance planning
Review and improve internal controls, approval workflows, finance policies, and accountability standards
Coordinate with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners
Clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, unresolved questions, risks, recommendations, and required next steps
Support financial clean-up projects, transitions, system changes, special reviews, and other senior finance initiatives
Provide senior leadership with accurate, timely, and decision-ready financial information

Required Experience And Qualifications

The successful candidate will have:

10+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, controllership, FP&A, corporate finance, or senior financial management
At least 5 years in a senior finance leadership position, such as Vice President of Finance, Director of Finance, Controller, Head of Finance, or an equivalent role
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field
A CPA, CA, CMA, CGA, MBA, or comparable senior finance qualification is strongly preferred
Strong experience reviewing complex financial records, reports, reconciliations, budgets, forecasts, and supporting documentation
Advanced understanding of financial reporting, cash-flow management, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and finance operations
Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards, financial models, trackers, memoranda, and management updates
Strong ability to identify financial gaps, inconsistencies, control weaknesses, process issues, and business risks
Experience working with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and executive stakeholders
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modelling, reconciliations, reporting, and structured data analysis
Experience using accounting systems and managing information related to banking, payroll, receivables, payables, vendors, clients, budgets, forecasts, and corporate records
Excellent written communication, documentation, and presentation skills
Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and attention to detail
Ability to manage evolving priorities and provide clear recommendations with limited supervision

Experience That Will Stand Out

Preference May Be Given To Candidates With

Experience overseeing finance across multiple companies, entities, business units, or operating divisions
Real estate accounting or finance experience
Property management accounting experience
Asset management or development accounting experience
Experience working in a founder-led, entrepreneurial, or rapidly growing organization
Experience improving an existing finance function rather than only maintaining established systems
Experience strengthening reporting, financial controls, documentation, systems, or cash-flow visibility during a period of growth or transition
Experience combining strategic finance leadership with hands-on financial review and problem-solving

The Leader Who Will Succeed Here

The right person is highly analytical but also practical.

They can review a large volume of financial information, determine what is reliable, identify what is missing, and separate immediate financial risks from lower-priority clean-up work. They are comfortable working with senior management and can explain complex financial matters clearly and directly.

They do not simply identify problems. They organize the work, establish priorities, recommend solutions, and create the reporting and financial discipline required to support better decisions.

They are equally comfortable reviewing detailed reconciliations, preparing executive reporting, coordinating with external advisors, and advising leadership on financial priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Success In This Role Will Mean

Leadership has clearer and more reliable visibility into the financial position of the group
Cash-flow requirements, financial obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions are easier to understand
Financial records and supporting documentation are organized, complete, and decision-ready
Management reporting is timely, accurate, and useful
Reconciliations, controls, approvals, and finance processes operate with greater discipline
Missing information and unresolved financial issues are identified and assigned clear next steps
Accountants, bookkeepers, advisors, and internal teams operate with stronger structure and accountability
The finance function becomes more scalable as Rothenbury Group continues to grow

Compensation and Opportunity

The base salary range for this position is C$180,000–C$200,000
, based on the candidate’s finance leadership experience, professional designation, multi-company background, technical capabilities, industry exposure, and overall fit.

The Successful Candidate Will Also Be Eligible For a Performance-based Annual Bonus Targeted At 15%–20% Of Base Salary. Bonus Performance May Be Assessed Using Factors Such As

Financial reporting accuracy and timeliness
Cash-flow visibility and forecasting quality
Strength of financial controls
Completion of reconciliations and financial clean-up priorities
Improvement in management reporting
Finance-process discipline
Quality of executive decision support
Progress in building a scalable and accountable finance function

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance leadership position with meaningful influence across a diverse and growing group of businesses.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
